'''Grathrax My Mediocre Light Side Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grathrax]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS5 TIGIH Grathrax LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Encampment (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Deck built to play my friend (only SWCCG player I know) for the light side, putting emphasis on endor.

*UPDATED!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published: the headers total 64 (Characters says 26 but the list has 23).
* Posted 'Luke Skywalker (a ds2 version)' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight (the Death Star II Luke; the strategy says he doesn't own it yet).
* Wise Advice and Battle Plan in the starting section dested the Effects (Special Edition / Endor), not the Reflections III shields.
* Posted Nar Shadda Wind Chimes dested the single Jabba's Palace interrupt Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes; Bonthan Spy dested Bothan Spy.

== Strategy ==

So after reading my review, I looked through the cards I owned, made some trades, etc, and came up with this.  I still need to get a DS2 luke (it doenst seem either is better than the others)his saber, and I feel the conflict.  So my deck doesnt quite look just like this yet.  But, I think it will do much better than before.  And I can use yoda, either on that naboo site or via encampment.
